questions.question_text: Three equal resistances of 3 Ω are connected in star. What is the resistance in one of the arms in an equivalent delta circuit?

questions.question_text: The function of choke and starter in a fluorescent lamp circuit is to
options: Reduce the power consumed by the fluorescent lamp
Create a high voltage across the tube during starting
Help to draw very high current during starting
Improve the power factor of the fluorescent lamp circuit

questions.question_text: Which of the following statements is true, according to Demorgan's theorem
questions.answer: De Morgan's Law states that the complement of a logical OR is the logical AND of the complements: (A+B)' = A'.B'.

questions.question_text: Connecting of inverters at all the inputs of an AND gate produces a
questions.answer: By De Morgan's theorem, an AND gate with inverted inputs functions identically to a NOR gate: A'.B' = (A+B)'.
